placements.title: Immediate Receipt Returns Decouple Execution from Retrieval to Prevent Lost Work
placements.frame: How does immediate asynchronous job dispatch with decoupled polling prevent lost work and blocking calls?
placements.why: Both expressions define and substantiate the architectural contract where remember returns an immediate receipt and delegates extraction tracking to cursor polling or piggybacking, eliminating blocking calls and lost work.
